_about: Settings of the Whose Dime voice notebook (S06). The one place for every number the voice uses (audit C5): the notebook form holds only the video, the mode and Franco's answers. Change a value here, by pull request to main; state.json records the values each run used.
_pauses_ms_source: audit C6.2 (250 / 450 / 700 ms); a quoted line as a question: voice_direction.md, assumed. Starting points, to tune by ear on the 20 s sample (D6)
_stretch_inner_pauses_source: assumed (S06): inside a block the model makes its own pause at a sentence end; when it is shorter than the target above, silence is added at the quietest point of the gap (never shortened). Turn off if it sounds stitched
_trim_source: assumed (S06): a block clip keeps 40 ms of its own silence at each edge, then the pauses above are added
_dry_ending_source: audit C6.3: last transcribed word ending less than 60 ms before the clip end, or sound still loud in the last 30 ms; redo with another seed, twice at most, then flag. 'Loud' = the last 30 ms within 25 dB of the clip's speech level (95th percentile of 10 ms frames): assumed, to measure on video 1
_rate_wpm_source: voice_direction.md, measured on the niche hits (n = 20): median 149, interquartile 142-154, 10th-90th percentile 138-161. Applies to the whole track (rate_total_wpm)
_similarity_min_source: Zehon voice notebook: a block heard at less than 80 % of its text is listed to re-listen

descriptions.A: Warm American male narrator in his mid-40s, General American accent. Conversational storyteller, as if telling a friend a story over coffee: relaxed, curious, a little wry. Medium-low pitch, clear consonants, natural rises on questions, lands the end of each sentence without trailing off. Not a newsreader, not a trailer voice, no hype.
descriptions.B: Warm American female narrator in her late 30s, General American accent. Conversational storyteller, as if telling a friend a story over coffee: relaxed, curious, a little wry. Medium-low pitch, clear consonants, natural rises on questions, lands the end of each sentence without trailing off. Not a newsreader, not a trailer voice, no hype.
descriptions.C: Warm American male narrator in his early 30s, General American accent, slightly faster and drier. Conversational storyteller, as if telling a friend a story over coffee: relaxed, curious, a little wry. Medium-low pitch, clear consonants, natural rises on questions, lands the end of each sentence without trailing off. Not a newsreader, not a trailer voice, no hype.

design._descriptions_source: voice_direction.md, 'VoiceDesign description to try first' (A, checked equal by a test) and its two variants (B: female, late 30s; C: male, early 30s, slightly faster and drier)
design.reference_text: So here's a question nobody asks at the checkout. If the thing is free, who's paying for it? Usually, it's not who you think. Picture an app that loses a million dollars a day. A million! And the people covering it have never even opened the app. Strange, right? Stick around. We're going to follow the money, one dollar at a time, and see where it lands.
design._reference_text_source: written in S06 for the reference only (never published): about 70 words, 20-30 s, with a statement, two questions, a number, a surprise and a wry aside, so the clone hears several intonations (audit C6, 'hypothesis to test next'; voice_direction.md V5)

_reference_import_source: S12 (D22): Franco's ElevenLabs clip in WhoseDime/Voice/elevenlabs/ becomes ref.wav. 24 kHz: the rate at which qwen-tts 0.1.1 extracts the speaker embedding (create_voice_clone_prompt, read in its source). Aim 20-30 s: design.reference_seconds of S06 (assumed; Qwen3-TTS's README only says '3-second rapid voice clone'). Refuse under 5 s or over 60 s: assumed. rate_wpm 135-155, assumed from one measure: in S11 a 171 wpm reference gave a 206 wpm clone (x1.2, CPU, one seed); aiming the clone's speech at 165-180 wpm (voice_direction.md, so that the whole track with the added pauses lands at 142-154) gives a reference of about 140-150. To correct on the first ElevenLabs sample (listen_20s.json against ref.json)
_blind_test_source: voice_direction.md, blind test for video 1 (D7): 20 sentences as 6-7 blocks from the cold open (start), the decision beat (about 25 % of the words) and one gear-step (about 50 %); version A one clip per sentence with 300 ms between
